main_text.p: in formas malo oppositas immutandi & refingendi, nec coctorum vaforum inftar adhuc fumus inflexiles, ei operæ gnaviter benedicente Deo incumbamus.

p.i: Udum & molle lutum es: nunc, nunc properandus, & acri Fingendus fine fine rota.

main_text.p: Supereft Lectores rogem, ut fphalmata, quæ frequentius ac optaffem, commiffa funt, dum liber in loco unde aberam imprimebatur ex apographo, cui ultimam non potui adhibere manum, neque ejus impreffionis fpecimina videre, æquo mecum tolerent animo, nec dedignentur antequam ad lectionem fe accingant, eis corrigendis femihorulam impendere, ne dictorum fenfus vel nullus vel absurdus appareat. Minutula, quæ nulla difficultate agnosci possunt, ex fe quidem facile animadvertent: quæ momentosiora sunt, ex appofito Erratorum Indice emendabunt, fi placet, ac præterea ver-ba

page.notes: Printed text is a fragment at the page foot ("ba") which continues onto the next page. Some letters are uncertain due to the scan quality, notably the "fph" in "fphalmata" and the "ff" forms, which are long s in the print and are copied as s. The lines "Udum & molle lutum es" are in italic and are set as a separate passage.
